Name: Blend
Label: Blend
Description: Controls how the generated noise is combined with the current biome field.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Label: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the amplitude of the generated noise.
Params.Tooltip: Negative values invert the noise contribution.

Params.Name: Influence
Params.Label: Influence
Params.Description: Controls how strongly this generator contributes to the final biome output.
Params.Tooltip: Set to zero to temporarily disable the contribution without changing its settings.

Params.Name: MixMethod
Params.Label: Mix Method
Params.Description: Selects how the generated noise is blended with the source field.

Params.Name: AutoUseSeedTexture
Params.Label: Use Seed Texture
Params.Description: Uses the generated seed texture when one is available.
Params.Tooltip: Disable to use the inspector seed and coordinate field alone.
